turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular, easy-care options for everyday indoor greenery are the Snake Plant (Sansevieria) and the Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum). Both offer exceptional value, but they suit slightly different needs:
• Snake Plant: Ideal for low to bright light and requires very infrequent watering. It is incredibly forgiving and perfect if you want a sturdy, low-maintenance plant.
• Peace Lily: Thrives in low to bright indirect light and needs to be kept evenly moist. It displays beautiful shiny foliage and graceful white spathes, letting you know when it needs water by drooping slightly.
If you prefer a plant you can set and almost forget, the Snake Plant is your best fit. If you enjoy a more active watering routine and love classic green foliage with white blooms, the Peace Lily is a fantastic choice!
